title: Gen AI Content Brief
prompt: Create a complete Gen AI content brief about {{topic}} for {{audience}} in a {{tone}} tone. Include goals, structure, constraints, and success criteria.
sampleOutput:
Objective: Build a useful content brief for the target audience.
Key Sections: Overview, audience insight, messaging angles, content outline, CTA.
Constraints: Stay clear, practical, and aligned to the requested tone.

title: Gen AI Prompt Optimizer
prompt: Improve this Gen AI prompt for {{useCase}} so it is more {{tone}}, specific, and likely to produce reliable output. Return the revised prompt and a short explanation of the changes.
sampleOutput:
Revised Prompt: You are an expert assistant focused on [use case]. Follow these constraints...
Why this works: The revised version adds clearer task framing, output structure, and evaluation criteria.
